title: Synchronization via Bleaching (Spot Bleaching) Protocol
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.uteewje

steps.title: Prepare bleach solution
steps.instruction: Pipette ~20µL of the 2X bleach solution onto the unseeded portion of a new plate.

steps.title: Transfer gravid adults to bleach
steps.instruction: Pick approximately 10 gravid adults from the contaminated plate using a metal pick and place them into the bleach solution on the clean plate.

substeps.instruction: Avoid bringing excessive bacteria with the worms
Perform the picking process twice if necessary to ensure a sufficient number of gravid adults are collected

steps.title: Incubate for egg release
steps.instruction: Allow the worms to sit in the bleach solution for approximately 10 minutes until they break open and release the bleach-resistant eggs.

steps.title: Incubate plate overnight
steps.instruction: Leave the plate right side up overnight at 20° C.

steps.title: Verify L1 hatching
steps.instruction: Check the plate the following day to confirm that L1s have hatched.

steps.title: Transfer L1s to new plate
steps.instruction: Pick about 10 L1s onto a new seeded plate and continue growing them as desired.
